M/V Koprindo, Off Grays Harbor, Washington

2012-10-12
USCG Sector Columbia River contacted the NOAA SSC on 10/12/2012 to request a trajectory for an 82-foot vessel in the process of sinking approximately 15 nm off Grays Harbor, Washington. The vessel reportedly had 400-500 gallons of diesel aboard. A weather forecast, trajectory, and assessment of product persistence were provided verbally.
